description:
This file defines the NormalForm class within the Goteo
amespace, implementing form rendering and element management, including dynamic child element creation and unique ID generation.

classes.name: NormalForm
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering HTML forms with dynamic element handling, supporting nested elements and unique ID generation.

methods.name: uniqId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a given prefix.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Recursively processes child elements, instantiating appropriate element classes based on type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NormalForm object, processing input data and generating child elements.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to create and render a form instance.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the form using a view template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the form's HTML representation, avoiding exceptions.
